summary.overall: LIVE mode is justified for: Discord Nudges, Fallback Swaps, Story Scheduling, Evergreen Reposts, Auto-Promote Approved, Low-Risk Publishing. 2 capabilities are paused or need proof first.

capabilities.name: Discord Nudges
capabilities.reason: Low risk, low blast radius. Keeps research responsive.

capabilities.name: Fallback Swaps
capabilities.reason: A/B winners improve content quality automatically.
capabilities.evidence: Swap to winner hook when confirmed

capabilities.name: Story Scheduling
capabilities.reason: Stories are ephemeral — low blast radius if wrong.
capabilities.evidence: Low risk if branded template used

capabilities.name: Evergreen Reposts
capabilities.reason: Reusing proven hooks is efficient and safe.

capabilities.name: Auto-Promote Approved
capabilities.reason: Auto-promoting approved content speeds up workflow.
capabilities.watch: Monitor for drift — if approval rate drops, pause

capabilities.name: Low-Risk Publishing
capabilities.reason: Actual IG posting is highest-value autonomy capability.
capabilities.evidence: One wrong post can be deleted — reversible
capabilities.watch: Content filter must catch banned words. Test weekly.

capabilities.name: Lead Routing
capabilities.reason: HIGH risk — non-reversible routing. WhatsApp message cant be recalled.
capabilities.evidence: No real lead data yet — WhatsApp API not connected
capabilities.watch: Never route without manual gate on hot leads

capabilities.name: Budget Shifts
capabilities.reason: Meta Ads API not connected — placeholder only.
capabilities.evidence: Budget shifts are blocked until API connected
